name: apply_damage
description: Applies damage to a character or NPC. Temporary HP absorbs damage first; excess spills into current HP. HP cannot go below 0.

entity_type.description: Whether the target is a player character or an NPC.

entity.description: The slug or UUID of the character or NPC to damage.

amount.description: The amount of damage to apply.

damage_type.description: The type of damage (e.g., fire, slashing, necrotic). Used for narrative purposes only — resistances and immunities are not applied automatically.
